title: Home Mortgage Loans: mortgage insurance premiums and duration by program
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: mortgage insurance premiums and duration by program

This document states, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, the upfront insurance premium financed into the loan, the annual mortgage insurance premium, the original loan-to-value ratio (LTV) above which private mortgage insurance (PMI) applies, and how many years FHA annual mortgage insurance premium (MIP) is paid when the original LTV was 90 percent or less.

## Premiums by program

| Program | Upfront premium financed (% of base loan amount) | Annual premium, billed monthly (% of principal balance) | PMI applies when original LTV exceeds (%) | Years of annual MIP when original LTV was 90% or less |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1.75 | 0.55 | Not applicable | 11 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2.15 | 0.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.00 | 0.46 | 80 | Not applicable |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.00 | 0.32 | 80 | Not applicable |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 0.00 | 0.46 | 80 | Not applicable |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not applicable | Not applicable |

## Meaning of each column

- **Upfront premium** is the upfront mortgage insurance premium or the VA funding fee that is financed, stated as a percent of the base loan amount. For the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage the figure is the VA funding fee; for the FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage it is the upfront mortgage insurance premium.
- **Annual premium** is the annual mortgage insurance premium, billed monthly, stated as a percent of the principal balance.
- **PMI applies when original LTV exceeds** is the original LTV above which private mortgage insurance applies. "Not applicable" means the program sets no such threshold.
- **Years of annual MIP** is the number of years annual MIP is paid when the original LTV was 90 percent or less. Only the FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage sets this figure.

## Worked examples (hypothetical amounts)

- **FHA upfront premium.** On a hypothetical base loan amount of 300000.00, 1.75 percent of 300000.00 is 5250.00.
- **VA funding fee.** On a hypothetical base loan amount of 300000.00, 2.15 percent of 300000.00 is 6450.00.
- **Conventional annual premium.** On a hypothetical principal balance of 250000.00 in the Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, 0.46 percent of 250000.00 is 1150.00 a year.

## Points of judgement

- **Original LTV of exactly 80 percent (hypothetical) in a Conventional program.** 80 does not exceed 80, so the PMI threshold in the table is not crossed; an original LTV of 80.01 percent exceeds it.
- **FHA original LTV of exactly 90 percent (hypothetical).** 90 is "90 percent or less", so the 11-year figure in the table is the one that applies to that loan.
- **Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage.** Both premium percentages are 0.00 and no PMI threshold is set.
